why: I checked every command in both briefs. Most of them would run as written: `npm test`, `npm test -w packages/jsonl-lint`, the `node -e` import (its quoting and escapes are valid), `git merge-base HEAD origin/main`, and the `gh pr view`/`gh pr checks` calls. The verifier brief breaks the criterion, though. It sets the relative path `BIN=packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js` and puts a.jsonl, b.jsonl and bad.jsonl in a new temp dir. Every check then runs `node $BIN a.jsonl bad.jsonl b.jsonl` with bare file names. From the repository root the bare names don't exist. From the temp dir `$BIN` doesn't resolve. Either way these commands fail as written: you'd get read errors, or "Cannot find module". BIN needs to be an absolute path, or the files need temp-dir paths.
